commissionAppliesTo: 12% (1200 bps) of the completed, non-refunded net tour/activity subtotal (FareHarbor receipt_subtotal / operator net activity fare in USD) for attributed bookings after travel completion, excluding government sales or excise taxes, municipal port/harbor passenger fees, payment-processing fees, and cancelled or refunded seats.
commissionPaidBy: Destination Command Center (DCC) pays Welcome to Alaska Tours LLC out of operator/FareHarbor Affiliate Sales Network (ASN) commission proceeds collected from the fulfilling operator (e.g., Coastal Helicopters).
